digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with US Strikes Iran's Larak Island, Tehran Vows "Response And Punishment". Asia-Pacific carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर दुनिया की अगुवाई है, चेहरे पर चोट के निशान, मंत्री ने दिए जांच के आदेश; पुलिस ने क्या कहा? मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: US Strikes Iran's Larak Island, Tehran Vows "Response And Punishment"
articles.summary: The strikes took place on Sunday after US forces detected members of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps preparing the launchers to fire rockets carrying sea mines into the strategically important waterway, according to the official. US Strikes Iran's Larak Island, Tehran Vows "Response And Punishment".

articles.title: Before flood catastrophe, Nepal asked China for early warnings as risks mounted
articles.summary: Officials from Nepal and China had discussed strengthening cooperation three months ago, to monitor and respond to floods, weather and glacier-related hazards, according to an agenda prepared by the Nepali side and seen by Reuters. Before flood catastrophe, Nepal asked China for early warnings as risks mounted.

articles.title: Ukrainian Officials Blamed For 'Negligence' After Deadly Strikes
articles.summary: With at least 38 people killed in Russian air attacks on the Kyiv region, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said "terrible negligence" was a factor in the high death toll. Ukrainian authorities have pledged to investigate why a weapons storage depot was located close to a populated area. Ukrainian Officials Blamed for 'Negligence' After Deadly Strikes.

articles.title: Nepal struggles to preserve recovered bodies as flood toll touches 788
articles.summary: More than 900 workers are missing from hydropower sites and officials believe around 100 people trapped inside tunnels are alive; experts from India, China, and South Korea have joined the Nepal Army’s efforts to rescue these workers Nepal struggles to preserve recovered bodies as flood toll touches 788.

articles.title: ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda
articles.summary: On the shores of Nkondo, in Uganda’s Kikuube district, the day begins before sunrise. Fishers enter the lake to fish, while families around Lake Albert rely on its waters for food, income and daily survival. ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda.

articles.title: Bangladesh’s J-10CE fighter plan stirs China dependence fears
articles.summary: Bangladesh’s planned J-10CE purchase could significantly strengthen its airpower while tying that capability more closely to Chinese weapons, support networks and supply chains. articles.title: Zelenskyy Blasts 'Negligence' As Ukraine Mourns Dozens Killed In Russian Strike
articles.summary: Ukrainian rescue crews early on August 30 continued to search for victims of the deadly Russian attack outside of Kyiv, while local residents -- as well as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy -- demanded answers as to why explosives were stored in a warehouse so near private housing. Zelenskyy Blasts 'Negligence' As Ukraine Mourns Dozens Killed In Russian Strike.

articles.title: Was it a mistake for 99 Colombian guerrillas to lay down their arms?

articles.summary: When China’s Defense Minister Admiral Dong Jun visited Jakarta on August 21, he and Indonesia’s Defense Minister Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin agreed to deepen military cooperation. At a joint press conference, Dong said Indonesia and China would work together against the “malicious intentions” of foreign powers. The two countries also agreed to expand defense cooperation. articles.title: Trump Dismisses Fears Of Russian Strike On NATO: 'I Am Not Concerned'
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump told reporters that he does not believe Moscow will attack a NATO nation amid rising concerns that Russian President Vladimir Putin will strike a Baltic country or other member state to test the Western alliance’s resolve. articles.title: Ukrainian Drone Spots Desperate Plea For Help
articles.summary: After a Ukrainian drone operator spotted an SOS sign outside a destroyed home in the Donetsk region, a three-day rescue mission was launched to save a couple who were the last remaining residents of their frontline village. articles.title: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says
articles.summary: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL). UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues. Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says.

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Tracking Syria’s transition
articles.summary: As Damascus continues to rebuild after more than a decade of war – from the recent dissolution of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces to the United States’ removal of Syria from its sponsors of terrorism list – a top UN official warned the Security Council on Thursday that international support can help tackle outstanding challenges. articles.title: Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster
articles.summary: Amid reports that hundreds of people are still missing in Nepal and China after a floodwater surge slammed into towns and villages on Wednesday, aid teams have been working to reach communities cut off by the disaster. Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster.

articles.title: Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire
articles.summary: A July roadmap sponsored by the Board of Peace has failed to overcome obstacles that have mired Gaza’s ceasefire deal ten months on. A mix of sustained pressure and diplomatic guarantees is needed to break the logjam and centre Palestinian agency in the strip's recovery. Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire.

articles.summary: उत्तरी साइप्रस के तटीय इलाके में रविवार को एक दर्दनाक समुद्री हादसा हो गया. लगभग 270 यात्रियों और क्रू मेंबर्स को ले जा रही एक निजी कैटामारैन फेरी समुद्र में अचानक पलट गई. इस खौफनाक हादसे में कम से कम 7 लोगों की मौत हो चुकी है, जबकि 23 लोग अभी भी लापता हैं. यह फेरी किरेनिया बंदरगाह से तुर्की के तासुचू शहर के लिए रवाना हुई थी.

articles.summary: Rescue teams in the flood‑hit district of Sindhuli, Nepal, followed a stray cat that led them to a five‑year‑old girl buried in collapsed houses. The child had been trapped for two days before workers cleared the debris and brought her to safety. नेपाल में बाढ़ ने हर तरफ तबाही मचा दी है. लेकिन इस बीच राहत की खबर ये है कि 5 साल की बच्ची को सुरक्षित मलबे से निकाल लिया है.
